title: Completed CHANGE MANAGEMENT PLAN Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed CHANGE MANAGEMENT PLAN artifact data payloads (PMO-04.01.02).

change_philosophy_and_governance.description: Principles governing how change requests are evaluated, prioritized, and approved.

change_thresholds_and_triggers.description: Conditions and variance thresholds that necessitate formal change control submissions.

change_tracking_and_tools.description: Software tools and tracking mechanisms used to log and trace change requests.

minor_change_definition.description: Criteria for low-impact changes manageable within existing project tolerances.

major_change_definition.description: Criteria for significant changes affecting baselines, budgets, or critical path.

emergency_change_definition.description: Expedited protocols for urgent operational or security change interventions.

ccb_composition_and_roles.description: Designated members, roles, and voting authority within the Change Control Board.

meeting_cadence_and_quorum.description: Frequency of CCB meetings and quorum requirements for binding change approvals.

escalation_and_delegation_rules.description: Rules governing threshold-based escalation to executive sponsors or steering committees.

change_submission_workflow.description: Standard operating procedure for logging and submitting formal change requests.

impact_assessment_methodology.description: Cross-functional analysis evaluating scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk impact.

approval_and_baseline_update_protocol.description: Formal sign-off steps and procedures for updating affected baselines and plans.

communication_and_implementation.description: Process for communicating change decisions and tracking implementation progress.
